sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "products" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sku" TEXT NOT NULL, "oem_number" TEXT NULL, "part_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "brand" TEXT NULL, "retail_price" INTEGER NOT NULL, "trade_price" INTEGER NULL, "core_fee_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "base_unit" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'EA', "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_synced" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_synced" IN (0, 1)), "is_deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_deleted" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "vehicles" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "make" TEXT NOT NULL, "model" TEXT NOT NULL, "year" INTEGER NOT NULL, "engine_code" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_synced" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_synced" IN (0, 1)), "is_deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_deleted" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "product_compatibility" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "product_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES products (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "vehicle_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES vehicles (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_synced" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_synced" IN (0, 1)), "is_deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_deleted" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "stock_ledger" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "product_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES products (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "bin_location" TEXT NOT NULL, "qty_delta" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reference_type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'sale', "reference_id" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_synced" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_synced" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "customers" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "display_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "phone" TEXT NULL, "tax_id" TEXT NULL, "balance_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_synced" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_synced" IN (0, 1)), "is_deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_deleted" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "invoices" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "invoice_number" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "customer_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES customers (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "subtotal_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "tax_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "discount_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "core_fee_total_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "total_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "tax_rate_bps" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1800, "payment_method" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'completed', "issued_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_synced" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_synced" IN (0, 1)), "is_deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_deleted" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "invoice_lines" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "invoice_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES invoices (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "product_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES products (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "sku_snapshot" TEXT NOT NULL, "part_name_snapshot" TEXT NOT NULL, "brand_snapshot" TEXT NULL, "unit_price_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "quantity" INTEGER NOT NULL, "uom_factor" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "uom_label" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'EA', "core_fee_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "line_discount_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "tax_rate_bps" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1800, "line_total_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_synced" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_synced" IN (0, 1)), "is_deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_deleted" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "uom_conversions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "product_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES products (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "from_unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "to_unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "factor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_synced" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_synced" IN (0, 1)), "is_deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_deleted" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("product_id", "from_unit", "to_unit"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_outbox" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "operation" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "occurred_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "next_attempt_at" INTEGER NULL, "last_error" TEXT NULL, "is_acknowledged" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_acknowledged" IN (0, 1)), "acknowledged_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_settings" ("setting_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "setting_value" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("setting_key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "shift_closures" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "closed_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "invoice_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "gross_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "tax_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "core_fee_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "payment_summary_json" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "audit_events" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "event_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_type" TEXT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NULL, "message" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload_json" TEXT NULL, "previous_hash" TEXT NULL, "event_hash" TEXT NOT NULL, "occurred_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
